data.title: "Toby Lil" Quilt
data.medium_display: Cotton, pieced plain and satin weaves, some printed in a variety of techniques and some glazed; appliquéd with plain, twill and satin weaves, some printed in a variety of techniques and some glazed; quilted

data.title: Bedcover (Star Pattern)
data.medium_display: Cotton, plain weave; pieced with cotton, plain weave, printed; quilted; backed with cotton, plain weave

data.title: "A Wreath of Roses" Quilt
data.medium_display: Cotton, plain weave, pieced; appliqued with cotton, plain weave, printed, attached in buttonhole stitch; quilted; backed with cotton, plain weave

data.title: Unifinished 'Friendship Offering' Quilt
data.medium_display: Cotton, plain weave; glazed; some inscribed with sepia ink; cotton, plain weave; roller printed; and center of linen, plain weave self-patterned by main warp and ground weft floats; embroidered with wool in stem stitches

data.title: "Trip Around the World" Quilt
data.medium_display: Cotton, plain weaves; printed; pieced; backed with cotton, plain weave; quilted

data.title: Bedcover
data.medium_display: Silk and cotton, variety of plain, satin and twill weaves, some with supplementary and/or self-patterning elements; pieced; quilted; edged with silk, warp-float faced satin weave

data.title: Central Medallion Quilt with "Yankee Puzzle" or "Hour Glass"  Borders
data.medium_display:
Center: cotton, plain weave; embroidered with silk, cotton, and wool in buttonhole, chain, cross, single cross, feather, Roumanian, satin, single satin, stem, and twined double running stitches.
Squares: cotton, cotton and linen, and linen, plain weaves; block, copperplate, and roller printed

data.title: Bedcover
data.medium_display: Three panels joined: cotton, plain weave; block-printed-resist-dyed; backed with linen, plain weave; edged with cotton, plain weave tape; block-printed-resist-dyed; quilted with linen

data.title: "Double Irish Chain" Quilt
data.medium_display: Cotton, plain weave pieced with cotton, plain weave; printed; backed and edged with cotton, plain weave; printed; quilted

data.title: "Victory Quilt"
data.medium_display: Appliquéd and pieced quilt with raised areas (trapunto); dyed and undyed, cotton plain weave fabrics; cotton thread embroidery
